# Wrong registry login/password + useExecLogs: token must not appear in
# [exec] cmd/stdout/stderr lines, .events, or any agent-written $HOME file
# except .apinfra*. Clone is file:// so the cycle reaches docker login against
# an unreachable registry (same pattern as docker/docker_login_failed).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: app needing compose up'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'logging into registry 127.0.0.1:1'
stderr '\[exec\].*docker login 127.0.0.1:1 -u bot --password-stdin'
! stderr 'RegTokenSentinel99'
stderr 'done duration='

! exec grep -R --exclude='.apinfra*' RegTokenSentinel99 $HOME

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
containerRegistryHost=127.0.0.1:1
containerRegistryUser=bot
containerRegistryToken=RegTokenSentinel99
dockerLoginTimeout=5s
useExecLogs=true

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-secreg
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-secreg/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
